title: Conditional κ = 0.001263365464781156: eleven-stage R740 hosting with complete row bound
body:
## Result

Conditional **κ = 0.001263365464781156** (`315841366195289 / 250000000000000000`), **1.3877% above PR444**. The bit supplier binds at `1264963576077378514188 / 10^24`; the freshly rebuilt PR442 complex supplier remains `1267453159029119 / 10^18`.

Extend PR443's unchanged R740 rank138 local word to **eleven compressed stages, dimension78 and eight replicas**. PR442 idle-data hosting places every one of the **65,120 helper occurrences** on pending idle coordinates. The emitted program has 88 calls, 9,600 live and 9,609 physical families, no helper banks or padding, and rank deficit 3,264.

## New finite obligations

The largest child is 56, so two-level halving fails and **three levels** are explicitly checked. The prefix uses 153 bits, charged at 192. The three-level coefficient uses **513 bits**: the old 512-bit cap is rejected and the cutoff charges 1,024 bits.

The old coarse matrix-count row estimate would exceed the retained 20,161 allowance. A self-contained elementary orthogonal-cover count fixes this: successively choosing nonzero-norm orthogonal basis vectors gives `|O_m(q)| ≤ 2^m q^(m(m−1)/2) < q^(m(m+1)/2)` for odd q. For m=78, including all 9,609 physical families gives stock below `q^3090`; three-level halving plus the inherited 9,909 and 252 reserves gives **19,431 < 20,161**. Routing-time charges still use m². The inherited row-divisor statement and notices are preserved verbatim.

## Verification

Full Linux reconstruction and macOS quick mode pass, with identical exact geometry, operators, profiles, emitted instruction digest, finite invoices and margins; only timing metadata differs. Repository-native `make verify-joint` passes, including 16 tests.

The wrapper verifies 246 unchanged upstream source files and freshly runs PR444, including the complex phase replay. New checks cover 1,320 port/stage routes, all 9,340 unbanked scalar columns, the signed ten-wire identity, all 24 individually omitted bridge shears, every hosted owner/window/remainder and the complete 1,736,152-instruction digest. The independent audit rejects 22 template corruptions. Both rational moment engines, both finite invoices, six bootstrap levels, 47 strict outer inequalities, adjacent-grid and parameter controls pass. CI runs the full wrapper on Python 3.11 and 3.14.

```sh
python -m pip install -r research/e8-r740-replica32/parent436/requirements.txt
python -B research/r740-hosted-eleven/verify.py /tmp/r740-eleven-new
```

## Scope and attribution

This retains PR442's conditional idle-data hosting extension and all inherited all-size compiler, correlated dirty-helper, restored-work, common-grid, precision and analytic interfaces. It is not an unconditional multiplication theorem, κ=1 result or new Lean proof.

The extension, elementary row bound and release integration were prepared by chafreaky with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. PR386 geometry/global code, PR436/443 local reconstruction, DaysSky's PR442 hosting (Anthropic Claude assistance), PR444 integration and Henry Grant's PR234 row interface are credited in complete retained notices and exact source pins. Earlier contributors and assistance disclosures remain unchanged.
